name: Deadlift
description: Lift the bar from the floor to standing by pushing through your legs and driving your hips forward, with a flat back throughout.

source.title: Deadlift (ACE Exercise Library)
source.note: Standard exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Stand with the bar over the middle of your feet.
Hinge down and grip it just outside your legs, shins close to the bar.
cues: Flat back, chest up, stomach braced.
Push the floor away; keep the bar close to your legs.
Stand tall at the top without leaning back.
Learn it with a coach and light weight first.

prescription.note: Warm up with lighter sets first. Move slowly: about 2 seconds to lift or push and 2 seconds to lower, resting between exercises as needed.

keyframes.name: Set up
keyframes.cue: Hips back, back flat, hands on the bar.

keyframes.name: Stand up
keyframes.cue: Drive through your feet and stand tall.
